# `packslip create`

- **Usage:** `packslip create <FLAGS> <ARTIFACTS>…`

Create and sign a packslip for a release

Digests every artifact, infers os/arch/libc/format from file names (override with name:os/arch), and writes packslip.json plus packslip.json.minisig into --out.

## Arguments
- **`<ARTIFACTS>…`** — Artifact files, optionally as path:os/arch[/libc]

## Flags
- **`--project <PROJECT>`** — Package URL of the project, such as pkg:github/jdx/mise
- **`--version <VERSION>`** — The release version
- **`-k --key <KEY>`** — Secret key file from `packslip keygen`
- **`-o --out <OUT>`** — Directory to write into

  **Default:** `.`
- **`--url-base <URL_BASE>`** — Download URL prefix for the artifacts
- **`--source-repo <SOURCE_REPO>`** — Source repository URL
- **`--commit <COMMIT>`** — Source commit
- **`--tag <TAG>`** — Source tag
- **`--published-at <PUBLISHED_AT>`** — RFC 3339 publish time; defaults to now
- **`--sbom <SBOM>`** — SBOM URL
- **`--supersedes <SUPERSEDES>`** — The version this release replaces
- **`--provenance <PROVENANCE>`** — Provenance URL for every artifact (repeatable, positional order)
- **`-h --help`** — Print help
